plugin.note: Shadow warriors' crush defence (+19) is their lowest melee defence, so crush weapons work best; their ranged defence (+38) is the highest. Safespot through the fence by the pit scorpions or behind the fungus near the cavern wall. They are not undead, so the Salve amulet does not apply.

requirements: Completion of Legends' Quest is required to be assigned Shadow warriors.
Combat level 60 is required for assignment.
mechanics: Shadow warriors attack with slash melee at scimitar speed (4 ticks) with a max hit of 6.
Crush is their weakest defence (+19); ranged their strongest (+38).
They are NOT undead despite their ghostly appearance; the Salve amulet does not apply.
They are hidden on the minimap.
They become non-aggressive after time passes, like most monsters.

methods.label: Crush melee
methods.summary: Kill the 19 Legends' Guild Dungeon spawns with a crush weapon against their weakest defence.
steps: Fight the shadow warriors with a crush weapon.
Their low max hit of 6 makes the task low risk.
notes: Their stab defence (+43) is high; avoid stab weapons.

methods.label: Fence safespot
methods.summary: Safespot through the fence by the pit scorpions or behind the fungus near the cavern wall.
steps: Position behind the fence separating the shadow warriors from the pit scorpions, or behind the fungus near the cavern wall.
notes: Their ranged defence (+38) is their highest, so magic may be faster despite no documented elemental weakness.

styleOptions.label: Crush melee
styleOptions.summary: Crush weapons exploit their weakest defence (+19).

styleOptions.label: Ranged safespot
styleOptions.summary: Ranged from the fence or fungus safespots (note their +38 ranged defence).

styleOptions.label: Magic safespot
styleOptions.summary: Magic from the safespots against their +15 magic defence.
